summary: Iteration 36: Complete testing of Activity Stream and Share Profile features. All 17 backend API tests PASSED (100%). Frontend UI screenshots captured showing all new features working: Recent Activity section, View All Visits, Share/Report buttons on other user profiles.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing test users used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Activity Stream and Share Profile features fully implemented and tested. Backend endpoint GET /api/users/{user_id}/activity returns paginated activities with like_count, comments_count, is_liked, description fields. Privacy filtering works correctly (public only for non-friends, public+friends for friends, all for self). Profile endpoint includes comment_permission, has_diary, country_name on recent_visits. User visits endpoint returns has_diary and visibility fields. Frontend shows Recent Activity section with activity cards, View All link on Recent Visits, and Share/Report buttons on other users' profiles.
screenshots_captured: Own profile page (Test User) showing Recent Visits with View All link and Recent Activity section
Other user profile (Social Tester) showing Friends/Message buttons and Report/Share icons
User Visits page showing paginated list with landmark names, country names, dates, visibility icons, diary indicators, and points
